latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "gamma" skill for AI-powered presentations and documents via SkillBoss API Hub.

- Supports generating presentations, documents, and social media carousels from natural language prompts.
- Command-line scripts provided for generating content, checking status, and listing generations.
- Extensive customization: choose format, number of cards/slides, styling instructions, tone, audience, and image options.
- Integration with SkillBoss API requires SKILLBOSS_API_KEY for authentication.
- API usage and response details included for seamless automation.
